claims.text: The Ad ROI Calculator is a free tool published at blackarrow.ltd/tools
The calculator uses the owner's own inputs (spend, leads, close rate) run through a fixed model to produce an estimate
Calculator outputs are illustrative estimates based on fixed assumptions, not performance guarantees
The calculator is part of a free toolkit Black Arrow offers for service businesses
Platform connects quiz, form, and missed-call responses to one shared booking calendar
